features.blurb: Ready-to-place booking/reference codes across six books for the day's picks.

features.blurb: Probability forecasts for every fixture of the day — 1X2, BTTS, over/under and most-likely scoreline, plus popular-game highlighting and honest uncertainty flags.

features.blurb: Your closed-price value (CLV), model Brier score, calibration ECC and the full audited ledger under your own account.

features.blurb: Only forecasts that clear strict confidence gates, with stake sizing advice. Rarity is the point — rarely, never daily.
features.upgrade_hint: Tier 3 gets the diamonds the moment they clear the gate; Tier 2 waits until three hours before kickoff.

features.blurb: Every signal lands earliest on Tier 3, plus a signed weekly audit PDF of every pick and settlement under your account.
features.upgrade_hint: The exact edge the platform studies: earliness. This tier is the reason everything else exists.

features.blurb: Per-match BTTS yes/no, over/under 2.5 and the most likely scorelines from the Poisson model — high-volume forecasts for the daily board.
features.upgrade_hint: Tier 3 sees the micro pack two hours earlier than Tier 1, when the edge is freshest.

features.label: Algorithmic Parlay Builder
features.blurb: Correlated, size-gated multi-leg combos computed from the day's forecast board.

features.label: Portfolio Correlation & Covariance Engine
features.blurb: See how today's slate overlaps so a correlated day cannot wipe you out.
features.upgrade_hint: The syndicate layer: staking that survives real variance.

features.blurb: Real-time alerts when odds move hard toward a side — the sharpest, hardest-to-arbitrage signal in betting.
features.upgrade_hint: The steam radar fires minutes-to-hours before kickoff; early access is what makes it actionable.

features.label: Pick of the Day
features.blurb: The single highest-confidence forecast of the day, publicly explained with its supporting data.
features.upgrade_hint: Higher tiers receive the Pick hours earlier; free users only ever see it after the matchday settles.
